title: SMPGWorkflow
description: Declarative Workflow Language Specification for Social Media Post Generation

name.description: Human-readable name for the workflow run

format.description: Post format: 1:1 square carousel or 9:16 vertical reel

contentSource.description: Source of content/quotes: 'ai' (generate with Gemini), 'json' (explicit quotes in JSON), 'db' (load from local quote database)

topic.description: Core topic, vibe, or search query

dbCategory.description: Category to pull from when contentSource is 'db' (e.g. 'stoicism', 'discipline', 'grind', 'mamba_mentality', 'dark_luxury', 'villain_arc', 'tech_startup')

quotes.description: Explicit quotes array when contentSource is 'json'

bgType.description: Background style: 'ai' (Pollinations Flux AI image), 'plain' (solid color), 'custom' (user supplied image)

bgColor.description: Hex color code when bgType is 'plain'

imageUrl.description: Direct image URL when bgType is 'custom'

imagePath.description: Local filesystem image path when bgType is 'custom'

imageBase64.description: Base64 encoded image string when bgType is 'custom'

watermark.description: Handle or brand tag to display on slides e.g. @discipline_archive

apiKey.description: Gemini API Key (optional: can be supplied per-request, stored in app, or omitted if using json/db mode)
